candidateActorIdentity: Pin the reviewed source commit and all executed build hashes before launch; never change the frozen actor or reuse a mutated runtime as initial state.
treatment: Each action preparation waits once for the next real worker frame, with a requested 50 ms timer. A timeout falls back to the actual latest frame. Cancellation, fault and close release the waiter and retain real passive evidence. The exact complete-frame compare-and-execute guard and learning-before-fresh-forecast order remain unchanged.

preparationWait.wallTimeQualification: A JavaScript timer is not a hard real-time bound; report every observed wait and overrun, including timeout outcomes, without excluding slow attempts.

unchanged: initial session bytes, choices and learned parameters
stopped world files and player state
all initial and intervening real passive evidence is eligible exactly once
primaryMeasures: executed physical action or active observation windows / all new decisions
all action-start dispositions, including refusals and cancellations
wait outcome and duration; fresh prediction-to-motor duration
independent support coverage and observed terminal goal result
integrityChecks: matched source session bytes, world tree, restored learning digest and full evaluator protocol
one preparation token at most per attempted decision, one terminal disposition per token, no unrepresented token request
prepared complete anonymous frame equals the actual action start frame for every accepted execution
all action and passive archive intervals form one gap-free, non-overlapping chain; checkpoint/close tail reported separately
raw event counts, passive-window journal, decision journal and final cumulative counters agree
requiredSoftwareChecks: next frame, timeout, supersede/close/fault cleanup and no auto-retry regressions
passive learning precedes fresh prediction and exact frame mismatch still refuses
full active integration gate without weaker assertions or larger budgets
decisionRule: Archive the one candidate launch regardless of outcome. A complete 32-decision sample exceeding 6 true executions supports improved availability in this ordered development pair; 6 or fewer does not. A partial or faulted sample is reported as incomplete, not silently retried. An integrity audit passing does not itself mean availability improved or capability acceptance passed.
preserve: all failures and any launch deviation
limitations: One ordered development pair does not estimate a general causal speedup.
Different live timing can change later trajectories and learning costs even with an identical initial state.
Recorded receipts establish represented preparations and motor attempts; software tests and source review establish that an aborted pending wait cannot trigger an invisible retry.
This short peaceful experiment cannot establish useful retention, transfer, sustained autonomous learning or open multistage capability. Those remain separate subsequent tasks.
